title: Farewells
label: ch:farewells
canDo: I can end a Punjabi conversation politely and choose a farewell that fits the situation.

payoff.summary: Complete separate oral listening and speaking checks: hear a parting and say what it promises, then part three ways yourself — the formal sat srī akāl, the everyday phir milāṁge, and the blessing rabb rākhā. Independent Gurmukhi reading and writing remain blocked until #13068 teaches the forms.
payoff.note: The farewell lessons are migrated to schema v2, so this chapter is generated from them rather than hand-written. The payoff measures real oral capability without claiming untaught Gurmukhi production; romanization is evidence for spoken recall only.
